text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time to go abroad! I can't<n>afford to run
anything less than my<n>absolute best at my last
domestic<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My opponent today is Biko Pegasus,<n>who aspires
to be a hero. I'm no hero<n>myself, but I'll show her
exactly what<n>I am in today's race!
